title: Ɛnne a Ɛkaa Mmepɔw Ho
intro: Wɔmaa ɔkra trenee akyɛde ahorow a ɛyɛ nwonwa fi soro, na ɔbɛyɛɛ sodifo ne ɔkofo a na ɛte sɛ nea ne su ankasa ne abɔde ankasa afrafra. Wɔn asɛm no nam nkɔmhyɛ, ahenni, ne nsaanodwuma so nwene, na ɛma agyapadeɛ bi a ɛka bom wɔ ɔsoro adiyisɛm nkratafa mu.
clues: Wɔpaw me sɛ Allah akoa na wɔmaa me ahennie a ɛyɛ den wɔ nkurɔfoɔ a wɔapaw wɔn mu.
Ná mmepɔw ne nnomaa bɛka me ho de ahyɛ Ɔsorosoroni no anuonyam.
Dadeɛ bɛyɛɛ mmerɛw sɛ dɔteɛ wɔ me nsam, ɛnam Allah pɛ so.
Meyɛɛ akode a ɛbɔ wɔn ho ban a ɛbɔ akofo ho ban wɔ ɔko mu hyew mu.
Bere bi mitwaa sɔhwɛ a emu yɛ den mu bere a akasakasafo baanu bubuu baabi a mesom me mpofirim no.
Wɔka me ho asɛm ka sodifoɔ bi a ɔhyɛɛ mframa ne jinn ho — ɛfiri sɛ na saa sodifoɔ no yɛ m’ankasa m’asefoɔ.

arabic: أَنِ ٱعْمَلْ سَـٰبِغَـٰتٍۢ وَقَدِّرْ فِى ٱلسَّرْدِ ۖ وَٱعْمَلُوا۟ صَـٰلِحًا ۖ إِنِّى بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرٌۭ
verse: [Commanding him], "Make full coats of mail and calculate [precisely] the links, and work [all of you] righteousness. Indeed I, of what you do, am Seeing." (34:11)
